question: What is the other name for solid carbon dioxide?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dry ice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Dry Ice

 
 
• Dry ice is simply carbon dioxide that has been cooled and condensed.
 
• When it reaches ambient temperature and pressure, it bypasses the melting process and expands directly into carbon dioxide gas.
 
• Dry ice is made by compressing and cooling gaseous CO2under high pressure, resulting in liquid CO2.
 
• Dry ice is frequently used as a substitute for refrigeration for groceries and medical supplies due to its exceptionally low temperature of -78.C
 
 
 
• Uses of Dry Ice
 
 
• Dry ice is used to keep the sensitive asphalt at the proper temperature during transportation from the manufacturing factory to the job site.
 
• During breakdowns, use dry ice to keep the contents of the refrigerator cool.
 
• Dry ice is the most efficient and cost-effective way of keeping perishables cooled or frozen.
